units.source_text: 妹尼僧回内室去了。

en.t: The younger nun went back to the inner room.

units.source_text: 客人等待雨晴，不免心烦。

en.t: The guest waited for the rain to clear, and could not help feeling vexed.

units.source_text: 听见一个名叫少将君的尼僧的声音，知是旧人，便呼唤她，对她说道：“我推想从前的旧人都已散去，所以懒得来访。

en.t: Hearing the voice of a nun named Shojo no Kimi, he recognized her as someone from former days, called her over, and said to her, "I had supposed that all the old attendants from the past had scattered, so I have been slow to visit.

units.source_text: 你们会怪我薄情么？”

en.t: Would you blame me for being heartless?"

units.source_text: 少将君曾多年服侍已故的小姐，是个亲信的侍女，便回忆往事，对他说了许多可悲的话。

en.t: Shojo no Kimi had served the late young lady for many years and had been a trusted attendant, so she recalled the past and said many sorrowful things to him.

units.source_text: 中将问道：“适才我从回廊一端走进来的时候，正值一阵大风把帘子吹起，

en.t: The Middle Captain asked, "Just now, when I came in from one end of the corridor, a sudden strong wind happened to lift the blinds,

units.source_text: 我从帘隙望见一个人，垂发长长的，模样和普通人不同。

en.t: and through a gap in them I saw someone with long flowing hair, whose appearance was unlike that of ordinary people.

units.source_text: 出家人的居处怎么会有这样的人？

en.t: How could such a person be in a dwelling of religious recluses?

units.source_text: 此人是谁？

en.t: Who is that person?

units.source_text: 我正惊诧呢。”

en.t: I was truly astonished."

units.source_text: 少将君知道他已经看见浮舟的后影了，想道：“如果给他仔细看看，更要牵惹他的心呢。

en.t: Shojo no Kimi realized that he had already seen Ukifune from behind, and thought, "If he were allowed to look at her closely, she would stir his heart even more.

units.source_text: 从前的小姐相貌比现在这人差得多，尚且使他至今不能忘怀。”

en.t: The young lady of former days was far less beautiful than this woman, yet even she has kept him from forgetting her to this day."

units.source_text: 她心中盘算着，答道：“太太思念小姐，时刻不忘。

en.t: With these thoughts in mind, she answered, "My lady has longed for the young lady and has never forgotten her for a moment.

units.source_text: 正在无可自慰之时，忽然获得了这意想不到的人。

en.t: Just when there was no way to console herself, she unexpectedly found this person.

units.source_text: 近来朝夕相伴，以慰岑寂。

en.t: Lately they have been together morning and evening, easing her loneliness.

units.source_text: 大人不妨和她从从容容地见一次面。”

en.t: My lord, you might as well meet her once at leisure."

units.source_text: 中将想不到有这种事情，心中纳罕。

en.t: The Middle Captain had not imagined such a thing, and was inwardly amazed.

units.source_text: 但不知道是怎样的一个人，想必是非常美貌的。

en.t: Though he did not know what sort of person she was, he supposed she must be extraordinarily beautiful.

units.source_text: 这偶然的一瞥，反而使他心神不定。

en.t: That accidental glimpse only made his heart more unsettled.

units.source_text: 他想探问详情，但少将君始终不肯直告，她只是说：“过几时自然会明白的。”

en.t: He wanted to ask for the details, but Shojo no Kimi would not tell him directly, saying only, "You will naturally understand after a while."

units.source_text: 中将觉得：这样不客气地追问下去，也不成体统。

en.t: The Middle Captain felt that it would be improper to keep pressing her so bluntly.

units.source_text: 此时随从人等叫道：“雨停息了！

en.t: Just then the attendants called out, "The rain has stopped!

units.source_text: 天色也不早了！”

en.t: It is getting late too!"

units.source_text: 中将被催促，只得动身返京。

en.t: Urged on by them, the Middle Captain had no choice but to set out back for the capital.

units.source_text: 他走过庭前，折取一枝女郎花，站着信口独吟道：“缁衣修道处，何用女郎花？……”

en.t: As he passed before the garden, he broke off a spray of maiden flowers and, standing there, casually recited to himself, "In a place of black robes and religious practice, what need is there for maiden flowers? ..."
